propositions: Three near-identical walkers that discover a ticket's replacement link (checking deps for duplicates and inbound relationships for supersedes) are scattered across close_precheck.py and close_disposition.py with differing liveness checks and return types.

A single consolidated replacement_of() function in close_disposition.py with require_live and on_subject_unreadable parameters replaces the three walkers while preserving their distinct filtering behavior through one-line wrapper seams.

The consolidation walk (find_inbound_relationships conjunction with 'supersedes') must appear only once in src/rebar, guarded by a construct-uniqueness test that scans all modules except close_disposition.py and honors a reasoned # replacement-walk-ok escape marker.

_NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES must be structurally identical to DISPOSITION_CLASSES (same object, not merely equal) to prevent the two sets drifting apart as they did in bug frolicky-dependable-peccary.
